question: Who among the following has served as the Prime Minister of India for the longest time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Jawaharlal Nehru served as the Prime Minister of India for the longest duration.
 
• He held office from August 15, 1947, to May 27, 1964, a total of nearly 17 years until his death in 1964.
